_about: Public-domain Theologia Germanica (anonymous, fourteenth century, edited by Luther in 1516-1518) in English for the Word Hoard: Susanna Winkworth's translation of Pfeiffer's text (Longman, 1854) and Georgiana Malcolm's separate translation, Old German Theology (London, 1854), from Internet Archive scans. The work has no author; the shelf's identity check is the work's title. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

theologia-germanica-winkworth: Theologia Germanica, ed. Pfeiffer, tr. Susanna Winkworth, with a preface by Charles Kingsley (London: Longman, 1854)
theologia-germanica-malcolm: Old German Theology, a Hundred Years before the Reformation, tr. Georgiana Malcolm (London: Arthur Hall, Virtue, 1854)

_alternates.theologia-copies: Second 1854 Winkworth copy (theologiagerman00johagoog); Andover 1855 and 1860 and Macmillan 1874, 1893 and 1907 printings; CCEL anonymous/theologia (the 1893 Golden Treasury text)

theologia-germanica-malcolm.author: Title page read: 'Old German Theology, a Hundred Years before the Reformation, a preface by Martin Luther, translated from the German by Mrs. Malcolm', blackletter title garbled in the OCR ('OLD German C|e0l00j'); Arthur Hall, Virtue, 1854
